title: system.colorpanel
description: `system.colorpanel` opens the system color chooser and outputs the selected color, with a default output mode of floating-point RGB values in the 0–1 range. Send it a bang to open the panel, or provide a `#RRGGBB` symbol or RGB triplet to open it with a selected color; its mode can also produce integer RGB, hexadecimal, or Color datatype output.
